q: Is the intended use and target condition of the AI test stated?
Are recruitment, sampling and exclusions for the accuracy study clear?
hint: Consecutive/random sampling, flow diagram, exclusions with reasons.

q: Is the AI index test described so it can be replicated?
hint: Version, inputs, preprocessing, thresholds pre-specified or not.

q: Is the reference standard valid and applied independently?
hint: Rationale, blinding between AI and reference, adjudication.

q: Are accuracy measures reported with uncertainty and indeterminate handling?
hint: 2x2 table, sensitivity/specificity/AUC with CIs, handling of failures/indeterminates.

q: Are generalisability limits and harms of misclassification discussed?
hint: Spectrum, setting shifts, consequences of false positives/negatives.
